geneExpression.name: assay
geneExpression.documentation: The assay that produced the counts (e.g. 'Stereo-seq', 'Visium', '10x Chromium 3-prime').

geneExpression.name: count_type
geneExpression.documentation: What the stored values are: 'raw' for integer UMI or read counts, 'normalized', or 'log-normalized'. Analyses that assume raw counts must check this.

geneExpression.name: count_units
geneExpression.documentation: The unit of one count: 'UMI', 'read', or 'arbitrary' for normalized values.
